intro: Mobile boat detailing and gelcoat repair for Middleburg and North Florida. We come to your dock, home or marina and walk you through every detail when we finish.

mobile.title: We come to your boat.
mobile.intro: We come directly to your dock or home, so your day keeps moving.

points.name: Free on-site quote
points.text: A qualified detailer meets you, answers your questions and sends an estimate.

points.name: Repairs on location
points.text: A certified tech fixes gouges, dings and deep scratches where the boat sits.

points.name: Walk-through at the end

servicesIntro: Restoration for weathered boats. Protection to keep every boat looking new.

services.name: Professional Boat Detailing
services.text: Every component of your boat is cleaned, polished and sealed, with a machine seal of the gelcoat inside and out.

services.name: Boat Washes
services.text: A professional wash with Shurhold brushes, then force-air drying to prevent water spotting on glass and metal.

services.name: Gelcoat Restoration
services.text: Multiple techniques to fit any level of oxidation, bringing gelcoat back to a showroom finish.

services.name: Gelcoat Repair
services.text: 100% mobile repair for gouges, dings and deep scratches.

services.name: Ceramic Coating
services.text: Professional-grade ceramic coating on most boats and wave runners to protect against sun, dirt and stains.

services.name: Debadging
services.text: Decals removed, with wet sanding and polishing where needed to clear ghosting on the gelcoat.

why.name: Certified work
why.text: Certified in boat detailing, mobile gelcoat repair and ceramic coating.

why.name: Eco-friendly products
why.text: They use eco-friendly products on your boat.

whyTitle: What we give you that others don't.
howTitle: Back on the water in three steps.

steps.name: Call us
steps.text: Tell us what your boat needs: scratches, gouges, damage or a full detail.

steps.name: Get an estimate
steps.text: We give you an accurate estimate. We work with many area marinas, or you can bring the boat to us.

steps.name: Final check
steps.text: We go over the finished work with you before it leaves.
